spec_coverage.notes: PASS — every §12 test-plan item has a corresponding behavioral example; no ghost tests; auth delta falsifiable; mailer delivery verified. Details: (1) Ghost-test sweep: grep across the full spec diff found ZERO reflection-only patterns (no instance_method, no rescue_handlers, no be_a/be_kind_of type checks, no assigned-but-unused vars, no be_truthy/be_falsey). retry_on/CustomErrorAiSummary is tested behaviorally (perform_now/perform_enqueued_jobs + have_enqueued_job + real row-status/broadcast assertions), not via reflection. The two be_present on extracted_at are each paired with a strong exact assertion (Time.zone.parse ...to_i eq updated_at.to_i, and criteria eq). (2) Mailer delivery (pipeline rule 4): bulk_generate_ai_summaries_job_spec.rb 'zero-criteria job batch' stubs BulkJobApplicationAiSummaryResultMailer.failed to return instance_double(ActionMailer::MessageDelivery, deliver_later: true) and asserts have_received(:deliver_later) — the exact rule-4 pattern. (3) AUTH falsifiability — hiring-team member 'allows create': HiringTeamMembership IS created in the before block, and organization settings set hiring_team_ai_credits_control_enabled=false, which is LOAD-BEARING: under the OLD gate update_ai_settings? -> AiJobApplicationSummaryPolicy#can_use_ai_credits? = is_org_admin? || (is_org_user? && hiring_team_ai_credits_control_enabled?) the member (role org_user, setting false) evaluates to false -> would 403; under the NEW gate JobPolicy#update? = on_hiring_team? = is_org_admin? || record.users.include?(user), the membership puts the user in job.users (has_many :users, through: :organization_users, through: :hiring_team_memberships) -> true -> 200. So the test genuinely fails under the old gate. Traced: ai_job_criteria_controller.rb -> job_policy.rb:20-22,58-60 -> ai_job_application_summary_policy.rb -> job.rb:46-50 (users assoc) -> hiring_team_membership.rb; pundit_user defaults to current_user (no override in ApplicationController/BaseController), which the spec stubs. (4) AUTH outsider 'rejects create': org_user, no membership, not admin -> update? false -> Pundit::NotAuthorizedError -> user_not_authorized renders 403 (application_controller.rb:15-17). exists() passes first (outsider is in current_organization.jobs), so the 403 is specifically the authorize gate, not a 404; flipper is enabled and description present in that context, so removing authorize would let create proceed to 200 -> the :forbidden assertion is falsifiable. (5) Two non-blocking OBSERVATIONS (not findings, no bar met): (a) validate_auto_ai_summary_generation_spec.rb is a lighter mirror than validate_ai_summary_generation_spec.rb (1 fail message + in-flight, vs 3 messages + blank/pending/in-flight) — acceptable because the guard is the identical context.fail! ... if @job_application.job&.zero_criteria_extraction_failure? call and the underlying predicate's truth table is exhaustively covered in ai_job_criteria_spec.rb and the ValidateAiSummaryGeneration spec; re-testing all messages here would be redundant. (b) show? and update? are behaviorally the same effective set in this codebase (both = hiring-team member OR admin; SPEC §9 states 'same effective set'), so no test distinguishes update? from show?; not a defect because the code correctly uses update? and the meaningful adversary (old update_ai_settings? gate) IS distinguished. (6) No missing/extra spec files: the diff's 11 spec files exactly match §12's inventory (3 new + 8 modified). Develop-merge repair in bulk_ai_job_application_summaries_controller_spec.rb (rescore_requested + params: reshaping) and the textract_result_ai_trigger_spec.rb job_application.reload setup fix are both traceable test-harness edits within §12-listed modified files, not untraceable scope creep.
